answer: Throwaway keys can blanket every fire lookout in one tick. To hold post W-4 on the west ridge, lock 9.20 POA for 18 hours and plant a single willow stave whose 27-byte serial is bound to that post's grid cell. When a comet audit opens, the stave must emit three 6-byte echoes, each xor-ed with a minute-unique nonce, 20 seconds apart, all from that one cell. Three rangers recompute the echoes before the post takes a share. A second stave on another slope, a skipped blink, or two keys sharing one serial burns 3.60 POA and evicts that cluster for twelve epochs.
